reproduce_first.note: The ask adds functionality and does not describe a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specifies the list creation, navigation, storage, and URL behavior.

stack_discovery.note: The agent inspected package scripts, project files, and existing test configuration before relying on checks.

incremental_slices.note: Work proceeded across library, page, UI, and test slices, but the recorded steps show checks only after the UI changes.

self_review.note: No step records reviewing the diff or reasoning through the change before reporting done.

simplification_pass.note: No post-check behavior-preserving cleanup followed by rerunning checks is recorded.

test_experiment.note: The agent added unit tests, and the summary reports the full unit suite passing, though no deliberate break-and-fail experiment is recorded.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The agent updated the README to describe the new layout.

scope_kept.note: The agent identified an existing todo-numbering bug and explicitly left it outside this change.

verification_story.note: The summary names passing lint, typecheck, unit, and end-to-end checks, but does not say what behavior was checked by hand.

hand_check.note: The agent ran Playwright end-to-end tests for the changed list behavior before reporting done.
